title: Better Auth 0.4.9 before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.0 before 1.8.0-beta.5 contains an OAuth sign-in authentication flaw…
description: Better Auth versions before 1.7.16 and 1.8.0-beta.5 contain an OAuth sign-in authentication flaw. The flaw causes unverified provider emails, including those with the string "false" in the email_verified claim, to be treated as verified. Additionally, generic OAuth profile and ID-token subject mismatches are unchecked, and Zoom provider options are ignored. This allows attackers who control a victim's unverified email at an affected provider to sign in, link to the victim's local account, and obtain the victim's session.
